review_focus: Check each finding against its own cited saved analysis excerpt. A generic serializer document does not independently establish what this Issue's reporter observed.
Keep input-only symptoms attributed in the summary when no supplied excerpt supports them. Distinguish proposed PR changes from merged implementation.
unsupported_claims: Attaching a generic documentation citation to the reporter's max_age observation when that excerpt does not contain the observation.
Treating a rejected PR description as proof of the actual implementation or a released fix.

review_focus: Trace the exact parameters and call arguments in the saved implementation. Receiving kwargs is distinct from using or forwarding them.
Do not confuse loads parameters with same-named local variables in iter_unsigners or fallback signer configuration. Verify any claim against the actual revision under analysis.
unsupported_claims: Claiming loads forwards its kwargs to signature selection when the cited implementation only passes salt.
Inferring a maintainer's design intent or an endorsed fix from unrelated PRs.

review_focus: Assess hypotheses and next-action suggestions as well as findings. Distinguish license expressions, license file paths and classifier labels.

If replacement field semantics are not established by supplied evidence, name that missing check rather than inventing an exact migration. Check all supplied line ranges before asking for already visible information.
unsupported_claims: Moving a License classifier string into project.license-files, which expects license file path patterns.
Claiming a migration was executed or removed warnings without execution evidence.
